name: defect-requirement-in-summary
body:
## Summary

Users can request a password reset email. To stop inbox flooding, an account gets at most one reset email per 15 minutes; extra requests inside that window send nothing.

## Change and measurable outcome

- `POST /password-reset` with a registered email sends a reset email with a token.
- An unknown email gets the same 202 response, so the endpoint does not reveal which emails are registered.

## Changes

- New `requestPasswordReset` handler.

## Testing

- [x] Unit tests

## Notes for Reviewers

- Tokens expire after one hour.
